title: The purpose of this meeting is to finalize the Committee's interim work. The Committee will finalize bill drafts relating to elections, public records, as well as electricity load and utility issues. The meeting will be held in person in Cheyenne and remotely with a live video stream available on the Legislature's Website (www.wyoleg.gov). A limited number of participants can sign up to provide public comment virtually for a specified agenda item during the Committee's upcoming meeting.
